senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be moist, be saturated, drip.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:2:15">Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵃ</cite> top <he>משיִרְווּ</he> (not <he>שיורו</he>), v. <cite ref="M02585"><he>מַרְוִית</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 14b">B. Bath. 14ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 7b:9">Ber. 7ᵇ</cite> (play on <cite ref="T00454"><he>רוּת</he></cite>) <he>שזכתה … שׁרִיוָּהוּ להקב״ה וכ׳</he> she was privileged in that from her descended David, who delighted the Lord with songs and hymns.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 150">Midr. Till. to Ps. CL</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 34:5">Is. XXXIV, 5</cite>) [read:] <he>מַרְוֶה אותה ומפילהו לשרה וכ׳</he> he saturates it (the sword with blood), and brings her tutelary angel to fall, and then it (the sword) will come down upon her (Rome; v. Cant. R. to VIII, 14).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> <he>ירדו … ונ׳ העולם</he> rain fell, and the world was refreshed; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:15">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> (not <he>ונתרווח</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 665:5">Yalk. Lev. 665</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 888:2">Yalk. Ps. 888</cite> (corr. acc.). Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᶜ bot. <he>כשם שׁנִתְרַוִּיתֶם וכ׳</he> as you were saturated with the oil of inauguration for seven days &c.; a. e.
